About BawdicSoft

BawdicSoft is a software company founded in 2018 and headquartered at Farzana Building, Karachi, Pakistan. It is led by CEO Syed Bilal Hashmi and Director Muhammad Zubair, and works by the motto “Innovate. Transform. Succeed.” The company can be reached at info@bawdicsoft.com or +92 317 8866631.

Track Record and Clients

BawdicSoft has delivered 250+ projects for clients in 15+ countries, including the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia and the UAE. It maintains a 99% client satisfaction rate, and its team averages over 10 years of experience. Among its clients are Martin Mobarak, Jaedin Falcone, Robert Douglas Scott, Vincent Esposito, Nick Zaryaki and Elvis de Oleo. Clients typically see development costs 60% lower than building in-house and a 40% faster time-to-market. The company is ISO 27001 certified, offers a 2-hour response SLA, guarantees 99.9% uptime and provides 24/7 support coverage.

Services

In AI, BawdicSoft builds chatbots for customer support and lead capture, custom machine learning models, NLP systems, computer vision, recommendation engines, voice assistants, AI content detection and workflow automation, using tools such as Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face and LangChain. In blockchain, it delivers audited smart contracts, DeFi protocols, NFT marketplaces, decentralized exchanges, DAO governance, token launches, crypto wallets and Web3 dApps, mainly with Solidity, Hardhat, Web3.js and Next.js. In web development, it builds custom CRMs, e-commerce platforms, SaaS dashboards, marketplaces, booking systems, learning management systems, enterprise dashboards and Web3-integrated web apps on stacks like React, Next.js, Node.js and PostgreSQL.

HOLOVOX

HOLOVOX is a real-time AI call coaching product, currently live in beta, built around the idea of helping people be their best selves on every call. It listens to meetings in real time and tells the user exactly what to say, drawing on their own documents, deals, CRM and past calls. It joins Zoom, Meet or Teams silently, so the other person sees and hears nothing different, and delivers coaching to the user’s phone or HUD glasses.

It works in three steps. First, it listens, using Deepgram Nova-3 streaming for live transcription with speaker identification and sub-second latency, and it pauses automatically during silence to save minutes. Second, it whispers: coaching cards appear every 10 to 60 seconds depending on the plan, with instant objection rebuttals and closing prompts when buying signals appear. It also reads tone, tension, excitement and hesitation to coach the user on how to respond. Third, it briefs: when the call ends, the user gets a full session summary, win/loss pattern tracking and CRM-ready notes, with no typing and no follow-up panic.

HOLOVOX serves six groups. Sales teams get live objection handlers, pricing recall and competitor intel. Support agents get exact answers pulled from the knowledge base before the customer finishes the question. Recruiters get structured rubrics and follow-up questions while the candidate speaks. Consultants get frameworks, case data and client history, so junior staff can deliver senior-level insight live. Network marketers get coaching on recruiting calls and team meetings, and parents get a Companion mode that offers patience and perspective at the moments that matter.

The Companion tier extends this beyond work into relationship coaching, parenting support, daily decision-making, health and habit coaching, and mindset and focus. On the hardware side, there is the Holo Ring R99 for continuous health tracking and silent notifications, and the Holo Glasses (Luna and Legacy) for lightweight all-day wear, starting at $499. The apps run on iOS, Android, Mac and Web, with a free-forever tier, while the Enterprise tier adds SOC 2, SSO and custom retention.

Compared with tools like Otter and Gong, which summarize a call after it ends, HOLOVOX coaches during the call and suggests answers from the user’s own documents. Coming soon is HOLOVOX 360, a life-size holographic streaming experience where anyone in the world appears in your room, viewed through Meta Ray-Ban Display, RayNeo X3 Pro or XREAL glasses, along with multi-person holo events.
